description: osirAgentDelete: Stage removal of the user's AI agent (e.g. Hermes). DESTRUCTIVE: stops and removes the agent from the user's VPS. Its data folder (conversations, memories) stays on the VPS, and the VPS itself is NOT cancelled (that is deleteVpsInstance). Returns an actionId; present the summary and call executeConfirmedAction only if the user approves. Requires authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: osirAgentDelete
